label: D-I043-1

branch.text: W1.5 mutant: pre-7b701c9 — a postponed/cancelled committed game falls through to the abstract != P lock

contract.text: An undelivered pick whose committed game (primary or double-down) is postponed or cancelled is stale and regenerated from live games; it is never kept as 'already locked' because the postponed game's abstract status is not Preview.
contract.trigger: existing undelivered pick on a game with detailed status Postponed (abstract F)
contract.symptom_kind: wrong classification (locked, game_started_or_final) that short-circuits the cascade

level_justification: besides the MLB status and lineup lookups (get_game_statuses_detailed, get_game_statuses, check_confirmed_lineups, retry_urlopen), the tests replace the internal model cascade (bts.orchestrator.run_cascade) and policy loader (bts.strategy._load_mdp); neither is reached on the mutant path
